[TODO:es] Cut a cluster as a sign for Israel

[TODO:es] Tall walls rise above the plain.

[TODO:es] Remember the Lord goes before you
[TODO:es] Decide the land cannot be taken

[TODO:es] Israel must hear what is real.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Remember the Lord goes before you

fear_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] He who parted the sea is here.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Remember the Lord goes before you

report_back.text:
[TODO:es] Ten spies cry, "We are like grasshoppers."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Agree with the fearful ten
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Faith does not bow to fear.

[TODO:es] Let Joshua and Caleb answer

Give the floor to the faithful.

caleb_speaks.text:
[TODO:es] Caleb pleads, Joshua at his side.
"The Lord is with us. Do not fear."

choices.text: [TODO:es] Silence them to keep peace
[TODO:es] Stand with their faith before all

[TODO:es] Their words are the Lord's voice tonight.
Stand beside them openly.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Stand with their faith before all
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The camp turns to look at you.

[TODO:es] Pack your tent and leave alone
